method: Built-in image_gen; original generated artwork, not CC0 field photography

prompts.goods: Create ONE high-resolution photographic material-sample atlas for a realistic 1873 European harbour game. A precise 4 by 4 grid of equally sized square texture samples filling the complete square image, with NO borders, margins, separators, labels, lettering or text. Every square is a flat straight-on macro photograph of a continuous material surface, not a whole object, flat cross-polarised even light, no perspective, no highlights or cast shadows. The samples must not bleed across their square boundaries. Row 1 left to right: rough brown bread crust with small baked pores; pale cream crumb of sliced rustic bread; fresh red butcher's meat with natural fine muscle fibres; pale firm pork fat with subtle organic grain. Row 2 left to right: brown dry cured ham skin with wrinkles; mottled rosy red apple skin with tiny lenticels; rough dusty russet potato skin; tightly layered pale green cabbage leaf surface with fine veins. Row 3 left to right: orange carrot skin with fine transverse root marks; pale yellow onion skin with papery vertical striations; dull grey-silver fish skin with fine overlapping scales and no bright reflections; firm warm cream cheese interior with small irregular pores. Row 4 left to right: matte ochre cheese rind; uncoated old cream rag paper with fine fibres and restrained dirt; dark small angular coal fragments packed together, no glow; natural cream beeswax with fine worn casting marks. Very high clean photographic detail, muted period-appropriate colours, fine real microstructure, no stylised painting, no low-poly, no generic cloudy noise. Each material is an independent square texture photograph.

prompts.prints: One photographic texture asset: a straight-on flat cross-polarised photograph of a wooden religious-print seller's display board in Antwerp in 1873. Landscape aspect ratio about 96:52. EXACTLY EIGHT columns and FOUR rows of small rectangular devotional colour lithograph prints, all upright, each in a thin dark brown or muted antique gilt frame. Thirty-two prints total, aligned in equal cells with narrow brown wooden spaces. Repeated 19th-century Catholic themes with individual fine printed detail: Our Lady crowned in a blue mantle holding the infant Jesus, a red-mantled Madonna, the Sacred Heart, a simple crucifix against pale blue, Saint Anthony in brown with the Child, Saint Joseph in green holding a lily. Alternate these themes naturally, no words or lettering anywhere. Delicate vintage lithographic reproduction, realistic fine paper and ink detail, no pixel art or simplified icons. No foreground, no architecture, no perspective, no vignette, no glare, no cast shadows. Flat even light suitable for a base-colour texture; edge-to-edge display board fills the complete image. The individual print art should look like photographed antique devotional prints, not 3D people in a grid.
prompts.bronze-patina: Produce a single seamless PBR base-colour photograph texture, flat orthographic close-up, covering a 50 centimetre square of old cast statuary bronze in an 1873 Belgian harbour. Real photographic macro detail, matte warm dark chocolate bronze, timeworn casting micro-pits and small abrasion pores, restrained irregular olive and green verdigris along tiny surface crevices, about 15 percent green coverage, larger quiet areas, natural nonuniform staining without a conspicuous motif. Flat cross-polarised overcast illumination, same even exposure across entire image, no baked specular glints, no cast shadows, no vignette, no perspective, no objects, no letters, no grid, no frame. Fine sharply resolved granular metal skin rather than blurry mottled noise. The whole image must remain an actual believable metal surface, not clouds. Full square edge-to-edge, tile in both directions.
